    toc: false
    df_print: paged
  
params:
  ref_id: placeholder 
  workingdir: placeholder
  scenario_list: placeholder
  assessment_tsvs: placeholder
  challenging_tsv: placeholder
  mapped_sam: placeholder
  unmut_sam: placeholder
  mut_sam: placeholder
  gff: placeholder
  db_hit_files: placeholder
  db_names: placeholder
  genome_length: placeholder
  window_size: placeholder
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# ── Package loading ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# All packages used in this report. They must be present in the conda
# environment defined in envs/r_report.yaml.
library(tidyverse)   # ggplot2, dplyr, tidyr, readr, stringr …
library(cowplot)     # plot_grid() and get_legend()
library(knitr)       # kable() for pretty tables
library(kableExtra)  # additional table formatting

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = FALSE,   # hide code from the PDF
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center"#,
#  out.width="50%",
#  out.height="50%"
)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = params$workingdir) #same as setwd but knitr needs to feel special
# ── Helper: parse a comma-separated parameter string ────────────────────────
split_param <- function(x) {
  # Returns a character vector; returns character(0) if x is blank / "".
  x <- trimws(x)
  if (nchar(x) == 0) return(character(0))
  strsplit(x, ",")[[1]]
}
```

```{r load_gff}
gene_start_stops <- read_delim(
  params$gff,
  comment="#",
  delim="\t",
  col_names = c("chrom","source","type","gstart","gend","score","strand","phase","attributes")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    id_ = grep("(?:ID=[0-9]_)[0-9]+(?:;)", attributes),
    query = paste0(chrom,"_",id_)
    ) %>% 
  select(chrom, query, gstart, gend)
```

```{r load variant calling}
vcr_names <- c("CHROM","POS","REF","ALT","Truthiness","scenario")
variant_calling_results <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = length(vcr_names), nrow = 0))
colnames(variant_calling_results) <- vcr_names 
  #c('ref_id','seq_id','position','ref_base','alt_base','mutation_type','detected','vcf_alt', 'vcf_freq','vcf_quality','above_threshold', 'replicate','replicate','scenario')

scenarios <- split_param(params$scenario_list)
assessments <- split_param(params$assessment_tsvs)
for(i in seq(length(scenarios))){
  temp <- read_delim(assessments[[i]])
  temp$scenario = scenarios[[i]]
  variant_calling_results <- rbind(variant_calling_results, temp)
}

variant_calling_results <- variant_calling_results %>% filter(CHROM == gene_stop_starts$chrom[1])

genome_len = ifelse(params$genome_length == 0, max(variant_calling_results$POS), params$genome_length)
#variant_calling_results <- variant_calling_results %>% filter(ref_id == sub(" ","_",params$ref_id))
```


```{r}
m8_file_cols <- c("query","target","fident","alnlen","mismatch","gapopen","qstart","qend","tstart","tend","evalue","bits")
me_hits <- data.frame(matrix(nrow=0, ncol=length(m8_file_cols)))
colnames(me_hits)<- m8_file_cols
db_names <- split_param(params$db_names)
db_m8_files <- split_param(params$db_hit_files)
for(i in seq(length(db_names))){
  temp <- read_delim(db_m8_files[[i]], col_names=m8_file_cols)
  temp <- temp %>% filter((evalue < 1e-10) & (alnlen >= 200))
  temp <- temp %>% group_by(query) %>% slice_min(evalue, n=1)
  temp$label = ifelse(db_names[[i]] == "tes_iss",ifelse(str_detect(temp$target, "Tn"),"Transposon (TnCentral + ISfinder)", "IS (TnCentral + ISfinder)"),ifelse(db_names[[i]] == "phrog", "Phage (Phrog)", db_names[[i]]))
  me_hits <- rbind(me_hits, temp)
}
duplicates <- read_delim(params$challenging_tsv,comment = "#", col_names = c("chrom","start","stop","name","score","strand"))
```


```{r}
me_hits <- left_join(
    me_hits,
    gene_start_stops
    ) %>% mutate(start = qstart + gstart, stop = qend + gend) %>% select(chrom, start, stop, label, evalue, fident, target)
problem_areas <- rbind(
    me_hits %>% select(chrom, start, stop, label),
    duplicates %>% select(chrom, start, stop) %>% mutate(label = "Has Close Homolog")
  ) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(chrom = sub("_[0-9]+$","",chrom))


```

```{r}
vcr_summ <- variant_calling_results %>%
  group_by(CHROM, POS,scenario) %>%
  slice_head(n=1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(POS = as.numeric(POS)) %>%
  arrange(CHROM, POS) %>%
  mutate(window = floor(POS / params$window_size)) %>%
  group_by(CHROM, window,scenario) %>%
  summarise(
    recalled_vars = sum(Truthiness == "TP"),
    missed_vars = sum(Truthiness == "FN"),
    false_pos = sum(Truthiness == "FP"),
    n=n()) %>%
  mutate(
    recall_pct = recalled_vars / (recalled_vars + missed_vars) *100,
    precision_pct = recalled_vars / (recalled_vars+false_pos) *100) %>% ungroup()


#detection_plot
```


```{r}
problems_plot <- problem_areas %>% mutate(level = factor(
    label,
    levels = c("Phage (Phrog)","Transposon (TnCentral + ISfinder)","IS (TnCentral + ISfinder)","Has Close Homolog")
    )) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = start, xend= stop, y=level, color=level), linewidth = 8
  ) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  xlim(0,genome_len) +
  labs(y="", x="Nt position") + 
  theme(text=element_text(family="Helvetica",size=12),
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x=element_blank())
#problems_plot
```

## Summary plots

```{r xmapping}
mapped_sams <- split_param(params$mapped_sam)
source_reads_ums <- params$unmut_sam
source_reads_mts <- params$mut_sam
for( i in seq(length(mapped_sams))){
  current_scenario = scenarios[i]
  current_mapped = mapped_sams[i]
  current_um_reads = source_reads_ums
  current_mt_reads = source_reads_mts
  sam_colnames <- c("qname","flag","rname","pos","mapq","cigar","rnext","pnext","tlen","seq","qual")
  mapped_reads <- read_delim(current_mapped, col_names=sam_colnames, comment="@") %>% select(qname, rname, pos, pnext, tlen) %>% filter(rname == variant_calling_results$CHROM[[1]])
  source_reads_unmut <- read_delim(current_um_reads,col_names=sam_colnames, comment="@")%>% select(qname, rname, pos, pnext, tlen)
  source_reads_mut <- read_delim(current_mt_reads,col_names=sam_colnames, comment="@")%>% select(qname, rname, pos, pnext, tlen)
  
  mapped_reads <- left_join(left_join(mapped_reads, source_reads_unmut, join_by(qname), suffix = c("_m","_umgt")), source_reads_mut %>% rename(rname_mtgt = rname, pos_mtgt = pos, pnext_mtgt = pnext, tlen_mtgt = tlen), join_by(qname))
  
  xm_same_genome = "XM Same genome"
  xm_diff_genome = "XM Different genome"
  correct = "Correct"
  mapped_reads <- mapped_reads %>% mutate(
    xmapped = ifelse(
      #is the mapped position inside the unmutated read positions (umgt -> unmutated ground truth) OR inside the mutated read positions (mtgt -> mutant ground truth)
      (rname_m == rname_mtgt & !is.na(rname_mtgt)) | (rname_m == rname_umgt & !is.na(rname_umgt)),
      ifelse(
        (((pos_umgt <= pos_m) & (pos_m <= (pos_umgt + tlen_umgt) )) | (((pos_umgt + tlen_umgt) <= pos_m) & ( pos_m <= pos_umgt))) | 
          (((pos_mtgt <= pos_m) & (pos_m <= (pos_mtgt + tlen_mtgt) )) | (((pos_mtgt + tlen_mtgt) <= pos_m) & ( pos_m <= pos_mtgt))), 
        correct, # mapped position is inside of the area the read was generated from
        xm_same_genome # mapped position is outside 
      ),
      xm_diff_genome # read comes from a different contig all together
      )
    )
  mapped_reads <- mapped_reads %>% mutate(window = floor(pos_m / params$window_size))
  mapped_reads_sum <- mapped_reads %>% group_by(window) %>% summarise(
    xmapped_same_genome = sum(xmapped == xm_same_genome)/n(),
    xmapped_diff_genome = sum(xmapped == xm_diff_genome)/n(),
    precision = sum(xmapped == correct) / n()
  )
  mapped_reads_sum <- mapped_reads_sum %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols=c(xmapped_same_genome, xmapped_diff_genome,precision),
      names_to = "label",
      values_to = "values"
      ) %>%
    mutate(label = ifelse(
      label == "xmapped_same_genome",
      "Same genome",
      ifelse(
        label == "xmapped_diff_genome",
        "Other genome",
        label
      )
    ))
  if(max((mapped_reads_sum %>% filter(label == "Other genome"))$values,na.rm=T) < 0.1){
    mapped_reads_sum_pltable <- mapped_reads_sum %>% filter(label == "Same genome")
  } else {
    mapped_reads_sum_pltable <- mapped_reads_sum %>% filter(label != "precision")
  }
  xmap_plot <- mapped_reads_sum_pltable %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=window*params$window_size, y=values*100, color=label)) +
    geom_line() + 
    theme_bw() +
    labs(y="Contaminantion Pct",x="Nt position") +
    xlim(0,genome_len) +
    ylim(0,100) +
    #scale_color_discrete_qualitative(palette = "Dark 3") +
    theme(text=element_text(family="Helvetica",size=12))
  detection_plot <- vcr_summ %>%
    filter(scenario == current_scenario) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=window*params$window_size, y=recall_pct, color=n)) +
    geom_line() +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(y="SNP Recall %",title=current_scenario) +
    xlim(0,genome_len) +
    theme(text=element_text(family="Helvetica",size=12),
            axis.title.x=element_blank(),
            axis.text.x=element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
            legend.position="none")
#xmap_plot

  main_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(detection_plot,xmap_plot, problems_plot, ncol=1, align="v")
#complete_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(main_plot, closest_genomes_legend, nrow=1, rel_widths = c(0.8,0.2))
#complete_plot
  print(main_plot)
}
```
## Regions with low recall ability or low precision

```{r}
recall_summary <- vcr_summ %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  filter((recall_pct < 90)|(precision_pct < 90)) %>%
  mutate(window_start = window*params$window_size,window_end = window*params$window_size+params$window_size) %>%
  select(CHROM, n, window_start, window_end, recall_pct, precision_pct, scenario) %>%
  rename(
    `Simulated Scenario` = scenario,
    CONTIG = CHROM,
    `N variants`=n,
    Start=window_start,
    End = window_end,
    `Precision`=precision_pct,
    `Recall`=recall_pct) 
kbl(
  recall_summary,
  booktabs = TRUE,
  caption  = paste("Detection summary for reference:", params$ref_id)
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"),
    font_size     = 10
  )
```

## Duplicated genes
```{r}
kbl(
  duplicates %>%
    select(chrom, start, stop, name) %>%
    rename(contig = chrom, `Gene name` = name),
  booktabs = TRUE,
  caption  = paste("Duplicated genes at 90pct ANI or higher:", params$ref_id)
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"),
    font_size     = 10
  )
```

## Regions with hits to supplied databases

```{r}
kbl(
  me_hits %>%
    mutate(evalue = log10(evalue)) %>%
    rename(
          contig = chrom,
          begin = start,
          end = stop,
           Identity = fident,
           Hit = target,
           Gene = query,
           `log10 evalue` = evalue) %>%
    select(contig, begin, end, Identity, Hit, Gene, `log10 evalue`) %>%
    arrange(contig, begin),
  booktabs = TRUE,
  caption  = paste("Hits against supplied ME databases:", params$ref_id)
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"),
    font_size     = 10
  )
```
